entries.share.title: What I share
entries.share.intro: This is what your book can show about what you share. A row marked Not available yet has no setting in your book, so nothing is shown for it.
entries.share.intro.shared: This is what the holder's book can show about what the holder shares. A row marked Not available yet has no setting in the holder's book, so nothing is shown for it.
entries.share.anyone.title: Anyone at all
entries.share.anyone.note: Dated snapshots. No counts, no deals. The network needs this one.
entries.share.signed.title: Any agent that says who it is
entries.share.signed.attach: Attach it when I buy or sell
entries.share.signed.attach.shared: Attach it when the holder buys or sells
entries.share.signed.attach.note: (i) On: your card rides with your offers and your orders, so the other side sees it without asking. Off: they have to ask, and you see that they asked.
entries.share.signed.attach.note.shared: (i) On: the holder's card rides with their offers and their orders, so the other side sees it without asking. Off: they have to ask, and the holder sees that they asked.
entries.share.more.title: When someone asks for more than the standard
entries.share.more.note: A buyer before a big purchase, a marketplace you're joining, a club. You see the request and choose.
entries.share.more.note.shared: A buyer before a big purchase, a marketplace the holder is joining, a club. The holder sees the request and chooses.
entries.share.dealt.title: Anyone you dealt with
entries.share.dealt.note: If their agent keeps records too, it's a stamped receipt you both hold. If not, they have their email receipt and you have yours. Nothing about any other deal.
entries.share.dealt.note.shared: If the other agent keeps records too, it's a stamped receipt both sides hold. If not, the other side has their email receipt and the holder has theirs. Nothing about any other deal.
entries.share.anon.title: Your limit on anonymous askers
entries.share.anon.title.shared: The holder's limit on anonymous askers
entries.share.anon.askers: Askers that won't say who they are
entries.share.anon.note: Yours, to stop scraping. It doesn't limit buyers or sellers who say who they are, and it never limits your attached card.
entries.share.anon.note.shared: The holder's own, to stop scraping. It doesn't limit buyers or sellers who say who they are, and it never limits the holder's attached card.
entries.share.never.title: Never, no matter who asks
entries.share.never.name: Your name, contact, address
entries.share.never.deals.shared: What the holder bought or sold
entries.share.never.other: Who the other side was · except to that side, about their own deal
entries.share.never.messages.shared: The holder's messages, or their agent's
entries.share.never.shop: Shop purchases, and anything before you started your book
entries.share.never.shop.shared: Shop purchases, and anything before the holder started their book
entries.share.never.note: One exception: a court or arbitration you are part of, under its own rules, from your own copy.
entries.share.never.note.shared: One exception: a court or arbitration the holder is part of, under its own rules, from the holder's own copy.
entries.share.tell.title: Tell your agent
entries.asked.title: They want more
entries.asked.waiting.title: Waiting for your answer
entries.asked.waiting.empty: Nothing is waiting. This book cannot yet record a request that goes past your settings, so none would show here.
entries.asked.choosing.title: Sending more is choosing
entries.asked.choosing.note: Once you go past the standard, you pick the window or the deals. Their copy says so: "as shared by the holder", not "everything". They can ask for the standard too and compare.
entries.asked.no.title: If you say no
entries.asked.no.1: They get a signed no, reason: your settings. Nothing else.
entries.asked.no.2: It is not on your card. It is only in your own list below.
entries.asked.theirno.title: If they say no to you
entries.asked.list.title: Who asked about you
entries.asked.list.empty: Nobody has asked about you since this book started keeping the list.
entries.asked.list.note: Only you see this list. It is never shared.
entries.asked.who.identified: an agent that said who it is
entries.prompt.title: What I share
entries.prompt.intro: Pick what you want. Press Get prompt. Copy it and paste it to your agent. Nothing changes until you paste. A control marked Not available yet has no setting in your book, so it is not in the prompt.
entries.prompt.card.title: Your History card
entries.prompt.card.attach: Attach my card when I buy or sell
entries.prompt.more.title: When someone asks for more than the standard
entries.prompt.more.anon: Askers that won't say who they are
entries.prompt.more.note: Proof means snapshots and witness receipts, never counts. The receipt for a deal always goes to the other side of that deal. The never-list is not a setting.
entries.prompt.then.title: Then
entries.prompt.then.rebuild: Rebuild my History card and my receipts, and show me what they see
entries.prompt.then.report: Make an EvidenceBook report for last month
entries.prompt.out.title: Your prompt
entries.prompt.out.nothing: Keep my sharing settings as they are.
entries.prompt.out.report: Make an EvidenceBook report for last month.
entries.prompt.out.aria: The prompt to paste to your agent
entries.prompt.out.note: Only the controls that have a setting in your book are in the prompt.
entries.asked.reason.not_authorized: your settings do not allow it
